# spaceman inbox

A space's inbox: list, show, add and triage items (--space).

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman inbox create`](#spaceman-inbox-create) | Add an item to the inbox |
| [`spaceman inbox get`](#spaceman-inbox-get) | Show an inbox item |
| [`spaceman inbox list`](#spaceman-inbox-list) | Inbox items, newest first |
| [`spaceman inbox set-status`](#spaceman-inbox-set-status) | Triage an item: new, in_progress, deferred, rejected or done |

## spaceman inbox create

Add an item to the inbox.

```sh
spaceman inbox create [flags]
```

API: `create-inbox-item` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman inbox create --space payments --title "Rotate the signing key" --body-file note.md --urgency high
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--attachment` | string, repeatable |  | attachment ID (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--body` | string |  | body (Markdown, or JSON with --content-type application/json; required) |
| `--body-file` | string |  | read --body from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--content-type` | string |  | text/markdown (default) or application/json |
| `--correlation-id` | string |  | correlation ID |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--title` | string |  | title |
| `--urgency` | string |  | low, normal, high or urgent |

## spaceman inbox get

Show an inbox item.

```sh
spaceman inbox get <item> [flags]
```

API: `get-inbox-item` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman inbox list

Inbox items, newest first.

```sh
spaceman inbox list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-inbox` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | bool |  | follow next_cursor and print every page |
| `--cursor` | string |  | continue from a previous page's next_cursor |
| `--limit` | integer |  | maximum number of items |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--status` | string |  | only items with this status (new, in_progress, deferred, rejected, done) |

## spaceman inbox set-status

Triage an item: new, in_progress, deferred, rejected or done.

```sh
spaceman inbox set-status <item> <status> [flags]
```

API: `get-inbox-item`, `set-inbox-status` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--defer-until` | string |  | with deferred: RFC 3339 time to bring it back |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--linked-id` | string |  | ID of a linked object |
| `--linked-kind` | string |  | kind of a linked object |
| `--reason` | string |  | reason |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
